item.title: smart Details Engineering Behind Sub-3-Metre smart #2 EV Ahead of Paris Debut
item.description: smart's two-seat #2 rides on a dedicated sub-3-metre EV platform with a 35.8 kWh CATL-cell battery, a roughly 300 km WLTP range target and a reworked Tridion safety cell.

item.title: Knowin Details GLOW Embodied Learning Framework for One-Shot Robot Teaching
item.description: Embodied AI company Knowin published a technical report on GLOW, a generative learning framework that lets home robots learn a task from one human demonstration, reporting 62.2% on RoboDojo and 86.7% on LIBERO-Pro under its own settings.

item.title: Xiaomi HyperOS 4 Stable Rollout Starts October 15 With Xiaomi 17 and REDMI K100 Pro
item.description: Xiaomi will start pushing stable Xiaomi HyperOS 4 in China on October 15, beginning with the Xiaomi 17 series, REDMI K100 Pro and K90 models and Xiaomi Pad 8 tablets, before expanding in waves through January 2027.

item.title: Kling AI Previews Kling 4.0 With 30-Second Native Clips and Multi-Reference Control
item.description: Kuaishou's Kling AI announced Kling 4.0 with single-pass clips of up to 30 seconds, up to 15 multimodal references and 10 keyframes; Kling 4.0 Flash opened to Ultra Yearly subscribers on September 28, with the full model due in October.

item.title: Alibaba's 27B XekRung Model Tops CyberGym Model Leaderboard at 88.9%
item.description: Alibaba Security AGI Lab's XekRung-1.5-27B-Preview, fine-tuned from Qwen3.8-27B, reached an 88.9% success rate on UC Berkeley's CyberGym Level 1 and now ranks first on the benchmark's model leaderboard.
